applies_to: Trumeter APM-PWR panel power meters with Modbus, per the Trumeter knowledge-base register map.
summary: Panel-mounted power and energy meter from the Trumeter APM family. Function code 4 input registers return 44 measurements as 32-bit floats (per-phase voltages, currents, powers, angles, power factor, THD, max load, totals and energy); function code 1 coils report ten alarm states.

addressing.note: The table lists a parameter number and an 'Address' that starts at 0 (frequency at address 0, L1-L2 voltage at 2); the address column is used directly as the wire address.

source.title: Modbus Register Map - APM Power (Trumeter Knowledge Base)
source.pages: single web page: input register table, coil table, 'Modbus Sentence Protocol'

notes: Word order: the page states the floats use two 16-bit words with the most significant word sent first, and each word high byte first (ABCD).
Values are the displayed values in whatever unit the meter is configured for (e.g. 415 for V or 8.7 for kVA), so units are not fixed here; check the meter's unit configuration.
Serial settings and default address are not given on this page; set them in the meter's configuration menu.
Transport is listed as RTU on the basis that the APM is an RS-485 panel meter; the page itself does not name the physical layer.
Unsupported functions return exception 1 and unknown addresses exception 2.

integration.summary: Read input registers 0-87 with FC04 as 44 big-endian floats, and coils 0-9 with FC01 for alarm states.
integration.enable: Not described on the source page.
quirks: Readings follow the configured display unit (V vs kV, kVA etc.).
setup: Set address and serial settings on the meter; they are not listed in the register map.
gotchas: The table spells parameter 39 'Reative Energy'; it is reactive energy.

verified.method: independent re-check of every register against the source PDF
